## HttpAdapterOptions.addressRateLimiter property

Per-client-address limit applied to requests before the credential is examined, or `false` for none.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly addressRateLimiter?: RateLimiter | false;
```

## Remarks

Transport protection, not policy: the subject-keyed limit in the runtime only counts calls whose credential verified, so without this limit credential guessing would be unbounded. A request whose address cannot be determined (such as an in-process `app.request`<!-- -->) is not counted, because there is no peer to protect against.

Adapters given the same limiter share one budget per address, which is how the macts server limits every runtime route together.
